liveBrowser.collection:
上海万体汇羽毛球馆
35 块场地
采集于 10/13 18:00

behavior: Floating mobile panel leaves 32px plus the system safe area below and 12px on each side.
Header and footer navigation stay visible while the body scrolls; controls have 44px touch targets.
Back to filters retains earliest start, latest finish, duration and selected weekdays.
Back to overview closes the panel and restores focus without scrolling the page.
Search filters all seven-day openings before limiting displayed results; more results expand in the same panel.
Every result fits its entire same-court continuous duration inside the requested time window.
Morning, afternoon, evening, custom half-hour windows, 1-6 hours and multiple weekdays are supported.
Search respects the main court selection and uses a shared duration; selecting a result reveals it in the full-day grid.
A visible results button jumps directly from the filters to matching openings.
Search is local; no new upstream or D1 queries and no additional slots request during the verified live interactions.
notes: WebKit iPhone simulation is not physical WeChat verification.
Existing working-tree changes preserved; no commit made.
No bookings, payments, credentials or reminders changed.
